messages:
Elaine (People Ops): Heads up 5: Priya handed in resignation, final day 2026-05-20. Opening offboard coordination here: asset return, access deprovision, benefits/COBRA, exit interview. Please claim tasks.

Raj (Eng Manager): Got it. I'll run the knowledge transfer and handoff doc. Can we keep Slack read-only for 48h after offboarding?

Theo (IT): I will start with an initial credential sweep today and remove any platform admin keys tied to her account. Proposed staged plan:
- Immediately: revoke admin-level AWS/GCP keys
- 2026-05-20 18:00 PT: disable primary login
- 2026-05-21 10:00 PT: revoke service-account keys after KV migration confirmation
I'll post audit output to ticket OFFBOARD-4821.

Maya (Security): Please check for any shared SSH keys or long-lived API tokens. If found, schedule rotations prior to 05/21. I'll prepare the audit log entries and link them to the ticket.

Elaine (People Ops): Priya has two deploy keys on GitHub and one GCP SA key. Raj 5: which repos still rely on her deploy key?

Raj (Eng Manager): Deploy keys: inference-runtime and infra-deploy. I'll remove infra-deploy key today; inference-runtime still needs her until KV migration completes 05/19.

Theo (IT): Quick audit commands I'm running:
```
# audit priya accounts
aws iam list-access-keys --user Priya || true
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --filter="user:priya@redwood.ai" || true
git ls-remote --keys | grep priya || true
```
I'll attach results to OFFBOARD-4821.

Payroll Bot: Payroll note: final paycheck will include hours through 2026-05-20. Benefits termination at 2026-05-20 23:59 PT. COBRA packet must be issued within 14 days post-termination. Please confirm mailing address on file.

Elaine (People Ops): Confirmed address in HR profile; I'll draft COBRA notice and send via email + postal.

Facilities (Ops): Asset return window: 2026-05-21 to 2026-05-23, 09:00-17:00. Keycard will be disabled 2026-05-21 09:00 unless manager requests extension. Please coordinate a drop-off time.

Priya (ex-employee): I can do the KV handoff walkthrough on 05/19 afternoon and drop the laptop at the office 05/21 morning.

Maya (Security): Noted. We'll do a final credential sweep after asset return. Theo, please schedule SA key rotation for 05/21 10:30 PT.

Theo (IT): SA key rotation queued for 05/21 10:30 PT. Admin keys revoked now. OFFBOARD-4821 updated with timestamp and reclaimed license list.

Elaine (People Ops): Action summary:
- Theo: audit + revoke admin keys (done) + rotate SA keys 05/21
- Raj: remove infra-deploy key today; KV handoff 05/19
- Maya: audit log and final sweep after asset return
- Facilities: accept laptop 05/21 morning
- Payroll: send COBRA notice within 14 days
- Elaine: schedule exit interview (proposed 05/22 11:00 PT)

Raj (Eng Manager): 05/19 KV walkthrough confirmed. 05/22 exit interview time works.

Theo (IT): OFFBOARD-4821 ticket created and linked; I'll close after SA key rotation and license reclamation.

Maya (Security): I'll verify rotation and close security checklist after laptop handback.

Elaine (People Ops): Using this thread as canonical. I'll post final closure summary when all items are complete. :white_check_mark:
